Danish Energy Agency and Energinet (2026). Technology Data for Energy Storage, version 0011 (latest amendment July 2026; first published October 2018). ISBN 978-87-94447-46-1. Danish Energy Agency, Copenhagen. www.ens.dk/technologydata

Guideline (report p.18): financial data in real 2020 EUR excl. VAT. Workbook Index sheet: cost data in 2020 EUR, except datasheets 141a, 141b and 142 in 2025 EUR (July 2026 update). 143a/143b state deflation from 2024 to 2020 prices (x0.87).

Read from the individual datasheets of technology_datasheet_for_energy_storage - 0011.xlsx rather than alldata_flat, because alldata_flat is stale for 141/142 (it still holds the pre-July-2026 single "141 Large hot water tank" and old 142 data) and omits the 143b Fixed O&M row; for all other sheets the datasheet values equal alldata_flat. Base year = first central year >= 2020 (2020 or 2025); lower/upper loaded as min/max only when printed for that same year (so none for Li-ion and VRB, whose uncertainty is given for 2030/2050). Pre-2020 historic columns (2015/2018/2019) and all later years go to _projections.csv. Loaded fully: 140 PTES, 141a TTES, 141b large TTES, 142 household tank, 143a rock and 143b molten-salt Carnot batteries, 150 gas cavern, 151a/b/c hydrogen tanks/LOHC/caverns: capacity (output MW, thermal-output; 151a compressor input), lifetime, construction time, round-trip efficiency (PtH system efficiency for Carnot batteries), capex, fixed and variable O&M, output temperature. Capex is the total specific investment per MWh of storage, rescaled to EUR/kWh with a storage-energy capacity basis in plain words; 143a has no total, so its energy component (EUR/kWh) and output (thermal-output) and input (electric-input) power components (EUR/kW) are three capex rows. Auxiliary electricity for thermal stores is in _flows.csv. Electricity storages 160-183: lifetime, round-trip efficiency and total capex only. Not loaded (in _other-values.csv): storage energy capacity (MWh), input capacities, charge/discharge efficiencies, storage losses per day/hour/period, outages, regulation, cost splits and components, power-to-power efficiency of Carnot batteries, storage/discharge temperatures, tank volumes, densities; the 140, 151b and 151c O&M rows whose units are contradicted by their notes; 143b variable O&M printed as % of investment/year.

(1) alldata_flat is out of date: it lacks the July 2026 141a/141b/142 datasheets and the 143b Fixed O&M row. (2) 140 PTES Fixed O&M printed as 2.5 M EUR/GWh/yr (=2.5 EUR/kWh/yr, over twice the capex per year) while note G says approx. 28,000 EUR/storage/yr (approx. 6 EUR/MWh/yr); not loaded. (3) 151b and 151c Fixed and Variable O&M printed in EUR/MW/yr and EUR/MWh with values of 1e-5 to 1e-6; notes say they are 4%/1% (LOHC) and a percentage (caverns) of capex, so they are really M EUR/MWh; not loaded. (4) 151a Fixed O&M 638 EUR/MW/yr: MW basis unclear (only MW printed is the 0.095 MW compressor), about 1% of capex per MWh. (5) 150 energy storage capacity printed 1,100 MWh but note B says one cavern is approx. 1.1 TWh; the specific investment 0.000237 M EUR/MWh matches the TWh reading. 150 Fixed O&M 1.27 EUR/MW/yr is implausibly low; no row notes or references. (6) Fractions printed in [%] rows: 140 round-trip and auxiliary consumption, 151a/b/c efficiencies (x100 applied where loaded). (7) Central values outside the printed same-year range: 140 construction time (1 vs 2-2), 151a input capacity (0.095 vs 0.1-0.99; 0.99 is likely a typo for 0.099), 151b round trip (0.72 vs 0.75-0.75), 142 variable O&M (0.84 vs 0-0.42), 161 CAES round trip (60 vs 55-55). (8) Lower/Upper columns on 141a/141b/142 are scenario ends, not ordered (Lower holds the larger value for capex, O&M, energy capacity); min/max reordered. (9) 143a prints separate per-MWh, per-MW-input and per-MW-output investment rows with no total; whether they are additive is not stated. (10) 143b labels a row Variable O&M but gives it in % of total investment per year. (11) 160 pumped hydro lower/upper investment printed as 0; lifetime range blank. (12) 180/181 uncertainty given for 2030/2050 only, not for the base year. (13) The 150 and 151a-c sheets list no references.
